description: This file contains code for training machine learning models from uploaded datasets. It includes functions for data preprocessing, model training (classification and regression), and artifact storage. It defines a data model for training results and a public interface for initiating training from a file upload.

classes.name: TrainingResult
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing the result of a training operation, including model ID, path, task type, target column, metrics, and timestamp.

methods.name: str _infer_task_type(y: pd.Series)
methods.description: Infers whether the task is classification or regression based on target data.

methods.name: Tuple[pd.DataFrame,pd.Series] _prepare_features(df: pd.DataFrame, target_column: str)
methods.description: Processes the input DataFrame to produce feature matrix X and target vector y, handling missing data and encoding.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame _read_uploaded_to_dataframe(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str)
methods.description: Reads uploaded file bytes into pandas DataFrame supporting CSV and Excel formats.

methods.name: _train_model(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series, task_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Trains a RandomForest model (classifier or regressor) based on input data and evaluates it.

methods.name: TrainingResult _store_artifact(model, meta: Dict[str, Union[str, int, float]])
methods.description: Stores the trained model artifact and metadata as files, returning a TrainingResult instance.

methods.name: TrainingResult train_from_upload( file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, target_column: Optional[str] = None, task_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Public interface to train a model from uploaded dataset file bytes, returning the training result.
